This performance correlates directly with the radiation length - F3 has the shortest relative radiation length (1x), followed by F2 (2x) and F1 (3x). Shorter radiation lengths allow for better shower development and energy measurement in electromagnetic calorimeters.

**Most Promising Material: Absorber-F3** with 3.2% resolution at 5mm thickness.

I'll refine the plate thickness for Absorber-F3 (the best-performing material at 5mm) by running additional simulations at intermediate thickness values to find the optimal configuration.
